name: Pairwise Network Alignment
problem_statement: Given two graphs and optional vertex-similarity priors, find a vertex mapping between them that maximizes conserved topology (and prior similarity, when supplied), either as a global one-to-one mapping or a local many-to-one set of high-scoring alignments.

normalization: Both graphs must use the same direction semantics.
Collapse parallel edges to a single edge, summing weight when weight_mode=edge_weight.

problem_inputs.name: alignment_mode
problem_inputs.description: Whether every vertex of the smaller graph must receive exactly one distinct match, or high-scoring local correspondences are reported independently.

problem_inputs.name: node_similarity_prior
problem_inputs.description: Optional external similarity (e.g. sequence or attribute similarity) between specific cross-graph vertex pairs.

problem_inputs.name: topology_weight
problem_inputs.description: Relative weight of topological conservation versus node_similarity_prior in the objective.

problem_inputs.name: top_k
problem_inputs.description: For local_many_to_one, maximum number of correspondences to return, ranked by score.

problem_inputs.name: solution_quality
problem_inputs.description: Whether a heuristic/approximate alignment with a disclosed objective value is permitted; exact is intractable beyond small graphs.

required_outputs.name: vertex_mapping
required_outputs.description: Pairs of (graph_a_vertex, graph_b_vertex, score) realizing the alignment.

required_outputs.name: objective_value
required_outputs.description: Total conserved-edge weight (edge correctness) plus weighted node_similarity_prior achieved by vertex_mapping.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: Whether every eligible vertex (global mode) or the full requested top_k (local mode) was produced.

optional_outputs.name: edge_correctness
optional_outputs.description: Fraction of graph_a edges whose mapped endpoints are also connected in graph_b.

optional_outputs.name: conserved_edges
optional_outputs.description: Edge pairs, one from each graph, whose endpoints correspond under vertex_mapping.

optional_outputs.name: approximation_bound
optional_outputs.description: Disclosed bound or confidence measure for an approximate alignment.

solution_semantics.objective: Maximize topology_weight times conserved-edge weight plus the sum of node_similarity_prior over the chosen vertex_mapping, subject to alignment_mode's cardinality constraint.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact mode requires optimal=true and is only expected to terminate on small graph pairs; approximate mode must disclose objective_value and, when known, approximation_bound.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: global_one_to_one maps each vertex at most once in each direction; local_many_to_one may map one graph_b vertex to multiple graph_a vertices across separate reported correspondences.
solution_semantics.ordering: vertex_mapping is ordered by descending per-pair score with a stable tie break.

validation_rules: global_one_to_one vertex_mapping is injective in both directions.
objective_value recomputes from vertex_mapping, conserved_edges, and node_similarity_prior within tolerance.
edge_correctness, when returned, equals conserved edge count divided by graph_a edge count.
Every vertex and edge referenced exists in its respective normalized graph.
edge_cases: Graphs of unequal vertex count under global_one_to_one map every vertex of the smaller graph and leave the rest of the larger graph unmapped.
Two isomorphic graphs admit a mapping with edge_correctness 1.0.
Disconnected input graphs are valid; alignment may map vertices across different components.
Empty node_similarity_prior degenerates to a purely topological alignment objective.
